title: ID0416696 - DC/Si-D/Fi -[udABVw] - Dispenser cable gland failure
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Another dispenser cable gland failure. Glands cannot hold the cable during preventive maintenance visit intervals
Root cause: Design
Solution: We will test Nordic solution for dispenser until HQ R&D offers official solution. Failure of cable gland is expensive and unnecessary and needs immediate actions from CPO / service partner. Preventive maintenance
